assessment.label: Supported hypothesis (team level): shift handoff. Corroborated by operational records and 4 separate comments.
reasons: Survey: material fall on q07 -0.82, q02 -0.81, q06 -0.33 (team level, n=11 to 13).

evidence_for.claim: Survey shows material and voice-related items fell substantially between waves.
Operational signal: late departures in the 06-07 band rose sharply in Jun–Sep versus Jan–May.

evidence_against.claim: A staffing shortfall occurred in March when coverage dropped below 90% of scheduled.
Rework counts do not show an increasing trend that would explain later departures.

missing: Rate of completed load checklists and handoff-log entries by night over time.
Nightly timestamps showing when load checklists are completed relative to shift end.
Monthly staffing levels for Jun–Sep to compare with March shortage.

brief.owner: Site Operations Manager, Priya Singh (Shift handoff procedure)
brief.proposed_test: For 30 days, require outgoing lead to complete and sign the load checklist and handoff log with supervisor spot checks; success = 06–07 late-departure rate returns toward Jan–May level (7.4%); review on 2026-10-31.
brief.limits: Small survey sample (n=11–13) and six comments; evidence shows correlation and corroboration but does not prove causation; one-month staffing dip is a competing factor.

assessment.label: Insufficient evidence: the survey moved but nothing else did. Watch item, no action proposed.
reasons: Survey: material fall on q06 -1.10, q12 -0.95, q03 -0.78 (team level, n=11 to 6).
Operations: no hour band changed materially (no signal).

evidence_for.claim: Three survey items showed material drops between waves.
Four survey items were essentially stable between waves.

Operational metrics show no material change in hours, rework, or staffing.
Employee comments are few and themes do not meet the breadth rule for corroboration.

evidence_against.claim: The observed survey drops may reflect respondent-mix changes rather than real team decline.
Small respondent counts (11 then 6) limit confidence in mean changes.
Comments are too few and duplicated to corroborate a theme-driven decline.

missing: More survey responses from the team in a new wave to reduce response-mix uncertainty.
Additional qualitative input from leaders or more employees to confirm themes.
Longer-duration operational signals aligned to the survey period for corroboration.
Item-level wave data with respondent identifiers to assess within-person change.
brief.owner: Not assigned: the evidence does not support naming a process owner.
brief.proposed_test: No test is proposed; run a 30-day focused collection to increase survey responses and qualitative feedback, track the same items and operations metrics; success = comparable item means and corroborating comments; review in 30 days.
brief.limits: Small sample sizes, large respondent-mix change, and single-source comment themes limit inference to a supported hypothesis rather than a verdict.
